models.description: All ADL forecasts use one Empirical-Bayes scoring model. Team strength combines 35% availability-adjusted Potential, 55% projected Starter Strength and 10% projected Roster Strength, with reliability and uncertainty learned together. Player forecasts use public Fantasy Sharks Week 1 priors updated by actual performances, opponent strength and availability. Weekly scoring variation uses a Normal-inverse-Gaussian distribution learned from normalized scoring history beginning in 2018. Bonus Games, H2H, All-Play and playoff odds use the same simulated scores.
